artDirection: HYBRID + AUTHORED VECTOR. Image generation is BLOCKED on this workspace (403 insufficient_permissions: image_video_generation), so all new art is hand-authored SVG rasterised to PNG — which is actually superior for flat vector: exact hex, zero gradient, precise outline weights, no derivative-work risk. Plants: flatten-pipeline experiment in progress. Original art only; Toca is the bar, never a source.

pieces.name: Toca standard + critic rubric
pieces.note: Rubric grounded in measured pixels from real Toca frames: pure #000000 outlines at ~1.4% of object height, absolutely flat fills (zero gradient/grain), pure white only 1% of pixels, 3-4 hue families, flat two-tone shading at dV 0.08-0.18. 10 scored categories; any category <=6 fails outright.

pieces.name: Three.js foundation (stage/tween/particles/textures/input)
pieces.note: Verified by screenshot: sprites on correct layers, DPR 1.75, 6/6 textures, live tweens, pooled particles, reduced-motion path, 44px hit enforcement, context-loss overlay. Agent found+fixed idle-loop suppression and degenerate-world bugs during its own verification.

pieces.name: Critters — flight paths & wing anim
pieces.gap: Layer is wired and completely empty (0 children) — a regression from the pre-port DOM game which had butterflies, bees, ladybug, bird, owl, bat and fireflies.

pieces.name: Plant expressions & personality
pieces.note: 6-state face rig built into the kit (neutral/happy/delighted/sleepy/surprised/mischievous) as swappable groups — enables blink and reaction animation.

pieces.name: Growth animation (seed→sprout→bloom)
pieces.note: Measured at standard: anticipation -11.6% over 133ms, overshoot 1.202x reciprocal, rotation kick unwinding through +1.34deg, layered celebration. Critic marked it do-not-regress.

pieces.name: Plant idle motion & secondary sway
pieces.note: Per-plant random phase AND period; judged in the motion review.

pieces.name: Plant art quality pass (78 plants)
pieces.note: Recoloured at the kit source: combined median S 0.630 -> 0.479, pixels above S0.60 59.4% -> 9.2% (both in target). Zero retired hexes remain; corners still alpha 0; fills still bit-exact to 530px. Now at the FAN-OUT GATE — a critic is judging both the 6 plants and whether the kit itself is rich enough to express 78 without everything becoming the same shrub.

pieces.name: Tap/press feedback & juice
pieces.gap: Taps on sky, hills, clouds and open grass produce 0 tweens and 0 particles; press cycle has zero rotation kick and zero position pop (both measured exactly 0.000).

pieces.name: Screen transitions
pieces.gap: Title screen is a plain 800ms crossfade and every modal/button uses default ease with no sibling stagger — 26 letter buttons all arrive on one frame.

pieces.name: Whole-game coherence pass
pieces.note: Fresh agent plays the entire game between waves.

pieces.name: Flat-vector world batch (sun, cloud, hill, grass, dirt, shrub)
pieces.gap: Every object is a full saturation step hotter than the reference — median fill S 0.63 vs spec 0.27, 86% of pixels above the S 0.55 ceiling — so it reads as loud clip-art rather than sunlit and washed.
pieces.note: Round 2 FAILED review: C1 5, C2 6, C4 6, C5 5, C7 4, C8 4. Critic verified the good parts too (flat fills to 2048px, outline weight 1.29-1.76%, zero gradients). Two hard bugs found: a 744px transparent hole inside a grass blade, and a clipped-stroke seam on 3 edges of the hill that would repeat when tiled. Round 3 fixing.

pieces.name: Game scene port to Three.js
pieces.gap: Everything that is not a plant or the sun is frozen and unresponsive — 8 dirt mounds, 8 sign posts, grass, hills and an EMPTY critter layer never move, and taps on sky/hills/clouds/grass produce literally nothing.
pieces.note: Motion critic measured frame-by-frame. C9 6/10 (motion fraction 26.4% vs >=30% rule). C10 auto-capped at 4 by linear easing on DOM confetti. Confirmed GOOD: press cycle reciprocal + volume-conserved, bloom anticipation -11.6% over 133ms, bloom overshoot 1.202x with rotation unwind, per-plant desynced periods.

log.msg: Branch toca-polish created; working game on main is untouched.
Vendored three.module.js r166 locally (house style: never load from CDN).
Spawned: Toca standard + critic rubric research.
Spawned: Three.js foundation build (stage, tween, particles, textures, input).
Clint approved HYBRID art direction + autonomous running.
Model policy set: Opus for art direction & critics, Sonnet for mechanical work.
Spawned: flat-vector world-art validation batch (cloud, hill, grass, dirt plot, sun, shrub).
Waves are driven by agent completions rather than a polling timer — each finished agent wakes the next stage.
Toca standard + critic rubric COMPLETE — docs/TOCA_STANDARD.md, 10 scored categories with hard fail gates.
Key measured finding: Toca uses PURE BLACK outlines and absolutely flat fills — art prompts corrected accordingly.
BLOCKER: creative_generate_image returns 403 insufficient_permissions (needs image_video_generation + flows). Zero credits spent.
Pivot: all new art is hand-authored SVG -> PNG. Better fidelity for flat vector than diffusion anyway.
Reviewed batch 1 renders directly (not the builder summary): flat + on-palette, but NO OUTLINES = C3 hard fail.
Wrote docs/FLAT_ART_BRIEF.md — mandates black outlines at 1.2-1.7% of object height, two-tone form blocking, deliberate irregularity, palette tokens, and the Chrome clipPath gotcha.
Three.js foundation PASSED — verified by my own screenshot, not the builder summary.
Foundation API: stage.js / tween.js / particles.js / textures.js / input.js + threejs-harness.html.
Wave 1 begins: porting the game world onto the Three.js stage.
Plant de-gloss verdict: NOT VIABLE. Verified myself — flattened butterfly bush lost its face; butterflies became blobs.
Root cause is fundamental, not tuning: in a 3D render, design edges and lighting edges have identical pixel signatures.
DECISION: author all 78 plants as native flat-vector SVG. Only route to the quality bar while image-gen is blocked.
Upside: authored SVG plants get a real swappable face system, so plants can blink, react and emote — static PNGs never could.
Spawned 6-plant pilot (sunflower, apple, maple, butterfly bush, pizza palm, UFO tree) to establish the shared plant kit.
World art round 2 delivered — my own look at the sun shows a dramatic leap: black outlines, form blocking, mismatched brows, real personality.

Builder found a genuine gap in MY brief: sun->sun-deep is only dV 0.059 and cream had no shadow token. Added 6 canonical shadow tones to FLAT_ART_BRIEF so 10 plant authors do not each invent their own.
Spawned independent critic for world art (fresh context, renders only, blind A/B vs a real reference frame).
Independent critic FAILED world art round 2 and lost the blind A/B. Excellent, measured critique.
Systemic finding: MY palette table was too saturated. Revised FLAT_ART_BRIEF with a desaturated set + a separate back-layer palette, before 78 plants inherit it.
Critic caught 2 hard bugs: transparent hole in grass_tuft, and an off-palette hairline seam on hill_layer from a viewBox-clipped stroke.
Sharpest note: the dirt plot is drawn as a MOUND when the mechanic is a hole you plant INTO — a game-design read, not just an art one.
World art round 3 building against the revised palette + 10-item fix list.
Scene port COMPLETE and committed — verified live in a fronted tab; sky, hills, clouds, sun, plots and ambient motes all rendering.
Process fix: rAF is suspended in BACKGROUND tabs, which made a builder think animation was dead. Critic brief now tells critics to front the tab and count ticks first.
Spawned motion/feel critic (C9 idle life + C10 response & juice) — judgeable independently of the art restyle.
My own read of the running game: a cloud collides with the HUD, clouds muddle the hill depth, and 8 repeated Grow-3-more text signs are heavy for pre-readers (instant tell 27).
Plant pilot COMPLETE: 6 plants + a shared kit expressed in code so 72 downstream plants inherit fixes automatically.
Caught before fan-out: the pilot used the OLD saturated palette (zero new tokens present). Recolouring at the kit source now — this is exactly why we piloted before scaling.
Pilot also caught 2 stale flatten-experiment PNGs with no SVG master (robot rosebush, zombie tree) — being removed so they cannot ship as authored work.
Kit documents 5 authoring traps found the hard way, incl. an evenodd fill-rule bug that put a floating orange disc on the pizza crust.
Motion critic FAILED the scene: C9 6/10, C10 4/10 (auto-capped by linear easing on DOM confetti).
Critic caught a subtle Three.js bug in its OWN method: Sprites rotate via material.rotation, not object3D.rotation.z — it re-measured everything on the correct channel.
Regression found: the critters layer is empty. The pre-port DOM game had butterflies, bees and night fireflies.
Accessibility bug found: reduced-motion mode removes tap squash entirely, so presses give ZERO acknowledgement. Reduced motion must reduce motion, not remove feedback.
Critic was honest that the blind A/B was inconclusive (reference video stalled) rather than inventing a verdict.
Growth animation PASSED at 8/10 and is marked do-not-regress.
Plant recolour COMPLETE: combined median S 0.630 -> 0.479, %>S0.60 59.4% -> 9.2%. Target hit.
Recolour agent caught MY error: the shadow-tone table in FLAT_ART_BRIEF still held old pre-revision hexes, contradicting the Layer-1 table above it. Re-synced.
It also found 2 hardcoded hexes in _build_plants.py bypassing the kit — now named tokens, so all colour flows from one source.
FAN-OUT GATE: critic judging the 6 pilots AND the kit fitness. 72 plants stay queued until this passes.
